description: Shows how a company's press release will look on LivePublicator, without signing in. Use when the user has company news to announce, for example a product launch, a new feature, a partnership or funding, including news they just wrote about in a blog post or article in this chat. Draft the whole release yourself from the chat: headline, one-sentence summary, body, key facts and questions and answers, plus the quote (name and role), press contact, company name and website, and an image URL if there is one. Returns every problem to fix at once, or a private preview page that expires after 7 days. The preview page has a button to publish it on the LivePublicator website. This tool publishes nothing.

body.description: The release body, 250 to 1,000 words, as text, Markdown or HTML. Do not repeat the headline. 3 links at most.

company_name.description: The company the news is about.

contact_name.description: Press contact's name, shown for journalists.

faq.description: Optional: up to 6 questions and answers.

headline.description: One line, 10 to 200 characters. Name the company in it.

image_is_ai.description: true when the image was made with AI (for example by you, at the user's request). The page then labels it "Illustration, created with AI".

image_url.description: Optional: a public https URL of a cover image (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB), for example from the company's website or blog post. 1200 px wide or more fills the page; from 600 px it shows at its own size. Under 600 px the release uses the cover card.

key_facts.description: 1 to 8 short facts, 5 to 200 characters each.

quote.description: A quote from a real person at the company. More quotes can go in the body.

quote_name.description: Full name of the person quoted.

quote_title.description: Role of the person quoted, e.g. Founder and CEO.

summary.description: One sentence that sums up the news (40 to 300 characters).

name: preview_press_release
title: Preview a release
